race.comment: OCCULT (2) showed his class two back with the 59kg when scoring over 1100m at Scone. Had no luck from the awkward gate when he came to town to finish eighth over 1000m at Randwick Kensington in BM72 class. Stalks the good tempo and should prove too good for these. CRESTA RUN (4) fitter after two runs back and indicated a win was imminent after she sat on the good tempo to run fourth over 1280m at this track. Proven at the trip and look for her late. GAIL JEANETTE (3) set a solid tempo with the big weight and paid the price in the straight when she tired to run tenth over 1100m at Bathurst. Was slow to recover on that occasion and gets another chance with Jacob Stiff taking the reins. WHERE'STHEPROFIT (1) consistent gelding resuming. Went out on a high after making it two straight wins at Scone over 1200m last October. Primed with the two trials and will prove hard to hold out. WHIL TO WIN (8) has a host of gear changes and gets in light with the claim.
